findings.summary: Kafka failure marks notices as NOTIFIED with no retry path — users can permanently miss balance-expiry warnings
findings.details: advanceToNotified persists status=NOTIFIED and notifiedAt before Kafka ack. If broker rejects/times out, notice remains notified and next sweep skips via notifiedAt idempotency check.
findings.recommendation: Use a durable outbox or a retryable notification state. Mark delivery only after event is durably handed off.

findings.summary: COMPANY wallet events broadcast to all partner-company users in client — cross-partner data leak
findings.details: resolveRecipients returns List.of() for COMPANY wallets. NotificationDispatcher role-broadcast path calls findByClientIdAndBaseRoleNames with no partnerCompanyId predicate, notifying PARTNER_ADMIN/PARTNER_SELLER users from unrelated partner companies.
findings.recommendation: Include partnerCompanyId in event metadata for COMPANY wallets and add dispatcher support filtering by clientId + partnerCompanyId + role, or resolve partner-admin user IDs before publishing.
